about.title: About Rhea Logistics
about.desc1: Rhea Logistics, born out of sheer vision, is a saga of a global corporate. We began with enterprises exporting and importing goods to and from India, and steadily built operational bases across vital business hubs.
about.desc2: We provide planning, implementing, and controlling of the efficient flow of goods, services, and information from origin to consumption.
about.mission_text: "Our main objective is to deliver excellent value to our customers & also create value for our employees & society at large."

services_overview.transport_desc: Equipped with Containerized and Body Trucks. We provide services across major cities and ports.
services_overview.freight_desc: Best freight rates with major shipping lines linking Kandla, Mundra and Pipavav to worldwide locations.

services_page.title: Our Services
services_page.subtitle: Comprehensive logistic solutions tailored to your business needs.
services_page.transportation_detail: Rhea Logistics is equipped with Containerized Trucks and Body Trucks. We make our repertoire of services available to clients across the country through our network of offices crisscrossing major cities and ports.
services_page.freight_forwarding_detail: We provide forwarding and shipping services to clients. With infrastructure catering to all needs of shippers, importers, and exporters, we offer best freight rates through contracts with various liners. We link Kandla, Mundra, and Pipavav to international destinations.
services_page.warehousing_detail: We have warehouse space available in and around Kandla & Mundra and its hinterland. Equipped with the latest communication and automation facilities, our warehousing is an integral link in the logistics chain.

services_page.other_list_7: Certificate of Origin, D.G.F.T Related Services
